guidetextdraw._value:
I. Purpose

These divisional guidelines establish a consistent practice for the administration of faculty assigned time. Awarding of assigned time is governed by the Collective Bargaining Agreement between the California State University (CSU) and California Faculty Association and Faculty Workload Policies and Procedures EP&R 76-36. Deans are responsible for ensuring compliance with workload policies and procedures and have authority to implement supplementary guidelines for their respective college. However, supplemental college standards must comply with CSU policy and the guidelines outlined herein.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1654861137817

guidetextdraw_2080741435._value:
II. Overview

Faculty teaching workloads may be adjusted to accommodate other instructional activities such as advising, course preparation, excess enrollment, and service to the college or university through special assignments known as assigned time. Below are general guidelines pertaining to the administration of assigned time.

 

  1. Assigned time weighted teaching units (WTUs) are normally awarded to tenured/tenure- track faculty. Lecturers and part-time faculty are awarded assigned time WTUs only for special circumstances.
  2. Faculty may receive no more than 12 WTUs of assigned time per semester; 3 WTUs per semester are designated as service credit.
  3. Classes with a census date enrollment over 120 students may be assigned 3 WTUs. A faculty member shall not be granted assigned WTUs for more than one class with excess enrollment. Classes with less than 120 students cannot be assigned 3 WTUs. However, those with a census date enrollment of between 75 and 120 and exceptional workload, a graduate assistant or student assistant may be allocated.
guidetextdraw_2080741435.name: textdraw_20807414351654861409334

guidetextdraw_2007237016._value:
III. Recording Assigned Time

It is the responsibility of the dean of the college (or their designee) to maintain record of all assigned time WTUs for their respective faculty. Assigned time records should be filed in a central location (e.g. the dean’s office) and must correspond to the assigned time entered into the CMS instructor term workload module. Terms and conditions of the assignment are documented on the division’s standardized request for assigned time form. A copy of the request for assigned time form and list of assigned time codes with definitions and uses are appended to these guidelines. Records of all assigned WTUs are subject to review and audit and must include:

  1. A full description of the specific task(s) to be performed;
  2. Number of WTUs assigned and appropriate assigned time code/reason;
  3. Formal approval of the assignment; and
  4. An after-the-fact evaluation of the assignment.
guidetextdraw_2007237016.name: textdraw_20072370161654861781704

guidetextdraw_52292625._value:
IV. Approval and Monitoring of Assigned Time

All assigned time must be approved prior to the term start date. Prior to approving a request for assigned time, department chairs are responsible for reviewing assignments to verify individual faculty workloads are appropriate. In addition, initiators of assignments (e.g. program coordinators, associate deans, FDC) must acknowledge their role in monitoring the work being performed. The dean of the college (or their designee) has authority for the final approval of faculty assigned time.
guidetextdraw_52292625.name: textdraw_522926251654862078775

guidetextdraw_2007236288._value:
V. After-the-fact Evaluation

Within 30 days of the assigned time term end date, a written summary of the work performed must be completed and signed by the faculty member awarded the time. The evaluation is then routed to the department chair, and if applicable the individual who initiated the work, for their final review and signature. For recording purposes, the department chair is responsible for ensuring the signed after-the-fact evaluation is appended to the corresponding approved request for assigned time form and filed centrally with dean’s office.
guidetextdraw_2007236288.name: textdraw_20072362881654862166440

guidetextdraw._value: Approval of this agreement is required by the Dean of the College prior to the faculty member beginning this assignment. Assigned time is approved for the dates and duties as described in the agreement only. A new agreement must be submitted and authorized if there are changes to the initial agreement. If the assignment described in this agreement is not completed or is not completed in a satisfactory manner, the Dean reserves the right to cancel this agreement. Extensions past the approved end date must be submitted on a new form.
